{{Top}}
[[File:Fireworks.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Fireworks across [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]] and [[Endor/Legends|Endor]], celebrating the defeat of the Empire]]
'''Fireworks''' were pyrotechnic displays used for celebrations. Some of them were delivered by [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-wing]] craft fitted with firework dispensers.

[[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] on [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]] was famous for its [[Fantasy in the Sky]] fireworks pageant.<ref name="COM">{{SWArchive|url=fans/events/celebration_v_startourspromo/index.html|text=New Star Tours "Commercial"}}</ref>
